title: The Stock-Bond Correlation: A Tale of Two Days in the U.S. Treasury Market
authors: Grace Xing Hu; Zhao Jin; Jun Pan
summary: Owned ES/ZN price fields overlap. Using the day's full correlation/top20% class inside that day would leak information. A causal estimator is a different hypothesis, not supplied net evidence.
about: Daily ES/ZN correlation identifies Treasury safety versus risk.
findings: Selected Table9 reports 0.15bp next-five-minute ES change per1bp UST change on bond-risky days, t2.65; not reproduced. Eq1 measures correlation across the COMPLETED day.
mechanism: Treasury-led risk can propagate to stocks, but ex-post day membership is unavailable at earlier entries.
build_on: Owned ES/ZN price fields overlap. Using the day's full correlation/top20% class inside that day would leak information. A causal estimator is a different hypothesis, not supplied net evidence.
can_strategy_code_be_made: Descriptive daily-state code feasible; no faithful entry-time regime strategy established.
reading_scope: Abstract, Eq1 pp8–9, selected intraday lead-lag text and Table9 pp44–45. Not a complete69-page review.
